description.html: The set contains two smaller sunken ships with broken masts, torn green sails and openings in the hull. The hulls are in warm brown tones with a blue stripe, and the overgrown sails make it look as if the ships have been underwater for a long time. One ship is slightly smaller than the other, so together they look like a scene from the seabed.

The advantage of the set is flexibility: you can place the ships side by side as one scene or spread them around the aquarium so more fish have their own hiding place. Because they are small, they also fit well in smaller aquariums, where one large ship would take up too much space.

Before placing them, rinse both ships in lukewarm water, without soap. Press them lightly into the sand or gravel so they stand firmly, with the openings facing the front glass. Clean the thin masts and sails carefully with a soft brush so you do not break them. For a complete theme, add an anchor or pirate skull from our supplies.
